title: National Smart Paddy Disease Prevention Workshop
location: Krishi Vigyan Kendra Demonstration Farm, Ludhiana, Punjab & Online Live
description: Interactive hands-on session on early identification of Paddy Blast, sheath blight, and bio-friendly Trichoderma soil treatment methods before the Kharif heading stage.

title: Organic Soil Health & Micro-Nutrient Dosing Camp
location: District Agriculture Office Ground, Nashik, Maharashtra
organizer: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Maharashtra
description: Free soil sample testing camp! Bring 200g of field soil to receive instant Soil Health Cards, N-P-K deficiency analysis, and customized organic bio-fertilizer recommendations.

title: Smart Solar Irrigation & PM-KUSUM Scheme Webinar
location: Virtual Zoom Webinar & YouTube Live Broadcast
organizer: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
description: Learn how to apply for up to 90% government subsidy on off-grid solar water pumps under PM-KUSUM Component-B and reduce farm diesel grid electricity bills.

title: Wheat Stripe Rust Surveillance & Climate Resilience Summit
location: Chaudhary Charan Singh Haryana Agricultural University, Hisar
organizer: Indian Institute of Wheat & Barley Research (IIWBR)
description: Pre-Rabi season orientation on high-yielding rust-resistant seed varieties (DBW 187, DBW 303) and drone-based precision pesticide spraying demonstrations.
